guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 加入 Retium Discord 和 Telegram
guide.description: 加入 Retium Discord 和 Retium Telegram 群组。水龙头与你的 Discord 帐户绑定，中断或重置将首先在 Discord 和 Telegram 宣布。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Join the Retium Discord and Telegram
guide.original_description: Join the Retium Discord and the Retium Telegram group . The faucet is tied to your Discord account, and outages or resets are announced in Discord and on Telegram first.

guide.title: 完成 Discord 验证测验
guide.description: 在 Discord 中输入 /quiz 开始八个问题测验。每个问题你可以尝试三次，答案在 Retium 文档中。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Type /quiz in Discord to start the eight-question quiz. You get three attempts per question, and the answers are in the Retium docs .

guide.title: 链接你的 X 和 Telegram 帐户
guide.description: 在 Discord 中使用两个机器人命令完成验证：输入 /link，在 X 上关注 Retium，从你的帐户发布验证消息，并将发布 URL 发送到机器人输入 /linktelegram 并按照提示连接你的 Telegram 帐户检查你的 Discord 个人资料中的 Cadet 角色
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Link Your X and Telegram Accounts
guide.original_description: Finish verification with two bot commands in Discord: Type /link, follow Retium on X , post the verification message from your account, and send the post URL to the bot Type /linktelegram and follow the prompts to connect your Telegram account Check your Discord profile for the Cadet role

guide.title: 创建 Retium 钱包
guide.description: 在浏览器中打开 Retium 钱包或安装 Chrome 扩展程序，然后创建钱包。离线存储 24 单词恢复短语。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the Retium Wallet in your browser or install the Chrome extension, then create a wallet. Store the 24-word recovery phrase offline.

guide.title: 注册 Retium Money 并领取启动资金
guide.description: 前往 Retium Money 并注册。链接你的 Discord 账户，作为一次性启动者以测试美元形式领取 $10。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Register on Retium Money and Claim Starter Funds
guide.original_description: Go to Retium Money and register. Link your Discord account to claim $10 in test USD as a one-time starter.

guide.title: 通过安全屋获取 RTD 和 RTM
guide.description: Retium Money 开放了完整的测试流程：测试美元、RTD（Retium 的稳定币）和 RTM Safehouse。将部分测试美元兑换成 RTD，使用 Safehouse 获取 RTM，然后将少量金额发送到另一个 Retium 地址。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Get RTD and RTM Through the Safehouse
guide.original_description: Retium Money opens the full flow for testing: test USD, RTD (Retium’s stablecoin), and the RTM Safehouse. Turn part of your test USD into RTD, use the Safehouse to get RTM, then send a small amount to another Retium address.

guide.title: 通过贡献者计划每天领取 $5 美元
guide.description: 在启动领取后，faucet 每天向通过贡献者计划在 X 上发布有关 Retium 的用户支付 $5 测试美元。每项每日领取都会在 48 小时后到期，所以不要让任何一个等待。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Claim $5 a Day Through the Contributor Program
guide.original_description: After the starter claim, the faucet pays $5 in test USD per day to users who post about Retium on X through the contributor program. Each daily claim expires after 48 hours, so don’t let one sit.

guide.title: 在 Launchpad 上铸造 NFT
guide.description: 打开 Retium NFT Launchpad 并连接你的钱包。创建一个集合，创建一个 NFT，并检查它是否显示在钱包的 NFT 标签页中。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Mint an NFT on the Launchpad
guide.original_description: Open the Retium NFT Launchpad and connect your wallet. Create a collection, mint an NFT, and check that it shows up in the wallet’s NFT tab.

guide.title: 交换并增加流动性
guide.description: 前往 Retium 测试网上的第一个 DEX Whisk，并连接 Retium 钱包。可以执行三种操作： 交换测试代币向池中添加流动性启动你自己的测试代币
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Swap and Add Liquidity on Whisk
guide.original_description: Go to Whisk , the first DEX on the Retium testnet, and connect the Retium Wallet. Three actions are available: Swap test tokens Add liquidity to a pool Launch your own test token

guide.title: 检查你在 Retium Explorer 上的活动
guide.description: 在 Retium Explorer 上搜索你的地址，以确认你的转账、铸造和掉期已被记录。该浏览器处于测试阶段，因此请报告 Discord 中丢失或错误的数据。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Check Your Activity on the Retium Explorer
guide.original_description: Search your address on the Retium Explorer to confirm that your transfers, mints, and swaps were recorded. The explorer is in beta, so report missing or wrong data in Discord.

faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。

sourcedDescription: Retium has not confirmed an airdrop, and its published tokenomics leave little room for a classic one. The team states that no RTM is allocated to any group. RTM enters circulation only through the Safehouse, an on-chain reserve that swaps Retium’s stablecoin for RTM one to one on the same terms for every user. No TGE date or tester reward has been announced, though the team has said members who test actively and file useful reports may receive a Beta Tester role in Discord.
tagline_en: Retium has not confirmed an airdrop, and its published tokenomics leave little room for a classic one. The team states that no RTM is allocated to any group. RTM enters circulation only through the Safehouse, an on-chain reserve that swaps Retium’s stablecoin for RTM one to one on the same terms for every user. No TGE date or tester reward has been announced, though the team has said members who test actively and file useful reports may receive a Beta Tester role in Discord.
